Container.Name: Keel
Container.Overview: Keel — a self-hosted lab for systematic crypto-perpetuals strategies. Claude drafts and invents strategies in the Shipyard; each is put through a two-year sea trial and ranked, then launched as a paper-trading Boat in your Fleet. Paper-first, with a deterministic risk engine that never asks a model anything.

Config.Name: WebUI & API Port
Config.Description: Single HTTP port serving both the Keel dashboard and Fastify API (route your Cloudflare Tunnel here).

Config.Name: Appdata Storage (/data)
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite WAL database, encrypted secret key, and market data store.

Config.Name: Backups Directory (/backups)
Config.Description: Mounted volume for scheduled and on-demand atomic SQLite VACUUM INTO backups.

Config.Name: Vault Master Key
Config.Description: Required. At least 32 characters with 12 distinct characters (generate with: openssl rand -base64 48). Keep it in your password manager: the vault cannot be decrypted without it.

Config.Name: Allow Plain-HTTP Sign-In (LAN testing)
Config.Description: Set true to sign in over plain http://[IP]:[PORT] on your LAN. Browsers refuse the Secure session cookie on plain HTTP, so sign-in silently fails without this. Leave false when Keel is reached through HTTPS (Cloudflare Tunnel).

Config.Name: Enable Scheduler
Config.Description: true fetches new hourly bars from OKX and steps your paper Boats. Without it, the Fleet never trades.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key (optional)
Config.Description: Lets Claude design and invent Boats in the Shipyard. You can instead store it in the Engine Room vault. Without a key the Shipyard offers samples, and Inventor via your chat still works with your Claude subscription.
